dashboard.purpose: Shows the team and project situation at a glance: total tasks, average progress, completed tasks, and problems needing attention.
dashboard.flow: Every number here is computed automatically from what's logged in Daily Report - there's nothing to fill in on this page.
steps: Open this page first after logging in to see today's overall status.
Check the stat cards at the top for the quick numbers.
Look at "Tasks per Project" to see which project has the most activity.
Watch "Active Problems" for unresolved issues.
Check "Team Workload" to see who's carrying a heavy load this week.
dashboard.note: This page is read-only monitoring - there's nothing to submit here.

daily-report.purpose: Where each employee logs the work done every day, per project.
daily-report.flow: Each entry has a date, project, task description, progress percentage, and a problem field if there is one. This data feeds Dashboard, Timeline, and Issue Log.
steps: Click "Log Task".
Pick the date and the project the work was for.
Fill in the task description and progress percentage.
If there's a blocker, describe it in the "Problem" field - it will automatically show up in Issue Log.
Attach a photo or file as proof of work if needed, then save.
daily-report.note: You can discuss a task with teammates through comments on that entry.

timeline.purpose: Shows every project's schedule as a Gantt chart based on start and end dates.
timeline.flow: Project dates come from Master Hub, while each bar's progress is averaged from Daily Report entries.
steps: Open this page to see which projects overlap in time.
Watch for projects with low progress but a near end date.
Use the date filter to focus on a specific range.
timeline.note: Read-only - to change a project's dates, edit it in Master Hub > Projects.

holidays.purpose: A shared work calendar marking weekends and holidays, so everyone has the same reference for which days are working days.
holidays.flow: Saturdays/Sundays are marked automatically. National holidays can be synced automatically by an Admin, or added manually for company-specific days off.
steps: Admin: pick a year and click "Sync National Holidays" to pull the official national calendar.
Admin: click an empty date to add a custom holiday, or click an existing holiday to remove it.
Everyone else: open this page to check which days are holidays or working days - nothing here can be changed.
holidays.note: This calendar also decides when the Attendance check-in modal should appear (it stays hidden on weekends and holidays).

attendance.purpose: Daily attendance - records presence (Present/Leave/Sick/Absent) along with clock-in and clock-out times.
attendance.flow: On every working day, a check-in modal appears automatically the first time the app is opened if that day hasn't been recorded yet. An Admin can set the standard work schedule and correct anyone's records.
steps: When the modal appears, pick a status: Present (clock-in is stamped immediately), Leave, or Sick (with a short reason).
"My Recap" tab: see your own attendance history and stats.
"All Attendance" tab: view everyone's attendance (read-only).
"Manage Attendance" tab (Admin): set the standard work hours and tolerance, correct anyone's clock-in/out or status, add manual records.
Use the period filter (Daily/Monthly/Yearly) in the top right to look at a specific range.
attendance.note: A "Late" badge appears automatically when a clock-in is past the work schedule plus the tolerance the Admin set.

issues.purpose: A list of problems reported through Daily Report, so they don't get buried in the day-to-day logs.
issues.flow: Whatever gets written in a task's "Problem" field automatically shows up here.
steps: Open this page to see every open problem.
Mark a problem resolved once it's been handled.
Use the filter to focus on what's still unresolved.
issues.note: Resolved problems stay on record as history.

overtime-business-trip.purpose: Requests for overtime and business trips (local/out-of-town), with a manager approval flow.
overtime-business-trip.flow: An employee submits a request, and an Admin or Manager approves or rejects it. There's a monthly summary and a per-employee rate setting for compensation.
steps: Click "New Request" and pick a type (Overtime / Local Trip / Out-of-Town Trip).
For Overtime: fill in the start and end time. For a trip: fill in the daily allowance.
Wait for approval from an Admin/Manager under the "Approval" tab.
Admin: set overtime/trip rates per employee under the "Rates" tab.
overtime-business-trip.note: Rates are set by Admin/Manager and are used to calculate compensation.

export.purpose: Downloads Excel/PDF reports from Daily Report and Overtime data for offline use (meetings, archives, clients).
export.flow: Pick a date range and a report type, and the file is generated from whatever data is currently loaded in the app.
steps: Pick a start and end date (leave them empty to export everything).
Pick a format (Excel/PDF).
Click "Generate" and download the file.
export.note: The downloaded file reflects the data as of that moment, not a live feed.

master.purpose: Manages the reference data other features rely on: projects, employees, project types, project statuses, login accounts, and the audit trail.
master.flow: Data set up here (like the project list) shows up as options in Daily Report, Timeline, Overtime, and elsewhere.
steps: Pick the tab for what you want to manage: Project Types, Project Status, Projects, Employees.
"Users" tab (Admin): create login accounts, assign roles, link them to an employee record.
"Audit Log" tab (Admin): review a history of important changes across the app.
master.note: Changing someone's role can only be done by someone who outranks them, and no one can change their own role.

profile.purpose: Manage your own account info: name, photo, email, app language, and password.
profile.flow: Everything here only affects your own account, never anyone else's.
steps: Open it from the profile menu in the top-right corner (click your name/avatar).
Update your name or profile photo under "Personal Info".
Switch the app language (Indonesian/English) under "Language".
Update your password under "Security" if needed.
profile.note: Your role can only be changed by an Admin, never by yourself.

notifications.purpose: Real-time alerts for things you need to know, like the status of an overtime/trip request.
notifications.flow: The bell icon shows a red count when there are unread notifications.
steps: Click the bell icon to see the notification list.
Click a notification to jump straight to the related page.
Mark everything read once the list gets full.
notifications.note: Notifications appear automatically when your overtime/trip request is approved or rejected.

chat.purpose: Team messaging: talk with colleagues in threads and share files or images.
chat.flow: Open a conversation, type your message and send. You can reply in threads, react, forward, and mention people.
steps: Pick a conversation from the list.
Type your message and press Enter to send.
Attach a file or image if needed.
Use @ to mention a colleague.
chat.note: Chat is open to every signed-in user.

theme.purpose: Switches the app's appearance between light, dark, or your system setting.
theme.flow: Your theme choice is saved in the browser, so it stays the same next time you open the app.
steps: Open the user menu (your avatar, top-right) and pick Light, Dark, or System.
theme.note: This setting only applies to the device/browser you're currently using.

logout.purpose: The menu for opening profile settings or signing out of your account.
logout.flow: Click your name/avatar in the top-right corner to open it.
steps: Click your name/avatar in the top-right corner.
Pick "Profile Settings" to update your account info.
Pick "Sign Out" to log out - you'll get a confirmation before it actually signs you out.
logout.note: You'll need to log in again after signing out to use the app.

leave.purpose: Requests for annual leave, permission (Izin) and sick days, with manager approval and a yearly leave balance.
leave.flow: An employee submits a request, an Admin or Manager approves or rejects it. Approved requests are written into attendance automatically for every working day in the range.
steps: Click "New Request", pick a type (Leave / Permission / Sick), the dates and a reason.
Track your requests and your remaining leave balance under "My Requests".
A rejected request can be edited and submitted again.
Admin/Manager: approve or reject team requests under the "Approval" tab (a rejection needs a note).
Click any row to see the full detail.
leave.note: Nobody can approve their own request. Only annual leave (Cuti) uses the leave balance.

payroll.purpose: Monthly payroll run: salary, overtime and trip allowances, deductions, payment status and payslips.
payroll.flow: Admin generates the run for a period, fills in deductions, finalizes it, then marks each employee as paid. Employees download their own payslip once the month is finalized.
steps: Pick the period and click "Generate payroll" - base salary, overtime and trips are pulled in from rates and approved claims.
Fill in PPh 21, BPJS and other deductions per employee while the run is still a draft.
Click "Finalize" to lock the month.
Mark each row as paid, and download a single payslip or all payslips as PDF.
Employees: your finalized payslips appear here for download.
payroll.note: A finalized period can no longer be changed; only the payment status can still be updated.
